title: realworld-frontend values
description: Schema guard for realworld-frontend chart values. Primary job: make a blank/missing image.repository, image.tag, or image.digest fail `helm lint`/`helm template` at render time, instead of silently producing a manifest with a broken image reference.

repository.description: Image repository (registry/repo path), without tag or digest.

tag.description: Image tag. A future CI step overwrites this value on each build.

digest.description: Image digest (sha256:<64 hex chars>) for immutable pinning.
